name: x-to-markdown
description: Convert X (Twitter) posts and long-form X Articles to Markdown. Extracts full article text with headings, lists, code blocks, cover images, and inline media using the free FxTwitter API. No API key or X login required.

commands.description: Convert an X post or article URL to Markdown and print it to stdout
Convert an X post or article URL to Markdown and save it to a file

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Path to the output Markdown file

parameters.name: download_media
parameters.description: Download images to an images/ folder next to the output file

examples: Save https://x.com/user/status/123 as article.md with images
